sources.snippet: Interests My work leverages big data analytics and AI to empower digital transformations. At Intermate, I utilize data-driven approaches to enable evidece-based decision-making across the entire social media value chain. In academia, I facilitated digital change in higher education, teacher education, and STEM education, as described on my research site.
